steps.action_code:
supervisor_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
account_passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
current_date_and_time = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()

def find_password(app_name):
    matches = [row["password"] for row in account_passwords if app_name.lower() in row["account_name"].lower()]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Could not uniquely resolve the password for " + app_name)
    return matches[0]

phone_password = find_password("phone")
venmo_password = find_password("venmo")
phone_login_result = apis.phone.login(username=supervisor_profile["phone_number"], password=phone_password)
venmo_login_result = apis.venmo.login(username=supervisor_profile["email"], password=venmo_password)
phone_access_token = phone_login_result["access_token"]
venmo_access_token = venmo_login_result["access_token"]
print({"profile_email": supervisor_profile["email"], "profile_phone_number": supervisor_profile["phone_number"], "current_date_and_time": current_date_and_time, "authenticated_apps": ["phone", "venmo"]})
